response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack web developer (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) but lacks nearly all core requirements for this embedded security role: no native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel investigation or source-modification experience, no networking security background (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching), and only brief C/C++ exposure from a 2014-2015 role. His career trajectory is oriented toward web platforms and developer tooling, not embedded firmware for LAN-switch products.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with solid craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some low-level and systems exposure via DLang, C/C++ at National Instruments, and Linux familiarity
Demonstrated ability to learn diverse stacks and work across web, mobile, desktop, and hardware-adjacent projects
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — native-level Japanese is a hard requirement
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
C for UNIX and Linux kernel modification experience is minimal and dated (brief stint in 2014-2015)
